newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Air France eyes Shanghai passenger service.
newsitem.headline: Air France eyes Shanghai passenger service.

text.p: Air France is considering a passenger service between Paris and Shanghai but planning is in the initial stages and the link is not expected to start until next year, a French airline source said.

"For the moment we have not decided anything such as what aircraft will be used or what date we will start, nothing is decided. But we are working on it and expect to begin in early 1998," he added in a telephone interview from Shanghai.
He said he could not confirm reports that the planned service will be an Airbus A340 non-stop service operating three times weekly.

Air France already has an agreement with Shanghai-based China Eastern Airlines Corp Ltd to share a Boeing 747-200 freighter between the French capital and Shanghai carrying an average of 65 tonnes ex-China and 25 tonnes from Paris. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
